name: jump by blocks then scan
mechanism: probe a sorted sequence at fixed strides until the target is passed, then scan linearly within the last block

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Jump search (or block search)' in section Combinatorial algorithms / Sequence algorithms / Sequence search: linear search on a smaller subset of the sequence

requires: a stride (policy; square root of length is the usual)
fails_when: worse than halving; useful only when backward moves are expensive
